quality.review_scope: Independent source and field review passed for the supplied eight-page main article after corrections. The R5 review digest correction and R6 component-index audit passed within their stated scopes. Supporting Information is not admitted, reviewed, or used. Publication and exact-coordinate training eligibility are separate.
missing_fields: No pressure, reactor capacity, centrifugation speed/time, retained fraction, isolated yield or dispersion concentration.
Underlying SI XRD, microscopy and size histogram data are not reviewed.
conflicts: Results gives 5 mL OLA + 5 mL ODE; Experimental gives 5 mL OLA + 40 mL ODE. No reconciliation is selected.

MSC-348 feed: Figure 1 caption and Experimental charge support 1:0.5:0.25:0.25; a later Results sentence calls 1:0.25:0.125:0.25 the “precursors” ratio. Product ICP ratio separately is 1:0.25:0.125:0.25.
Figure 1 is an aliquot/time-temperature series; it does not establish four independent physical batches.
